denominator_rules: Report row and known-population denominators separately for each year and source scope.
Retain official control gaps and unknown populations; do not fill residuals.
Do not count territorial aggregates as physical-locality points.
Show selected-source coverage separately from nationwide completeness.
No annual nationwide coverage claim from a city-only or partial source.
Crimea and Sevastopol are outside Russian census scope in 2002 and 2010.

loop.promotion: Only source-backed accepted rules or reviewed decisions enter reliable coverage.
loop.rejection: Keep failed/rejected attempts with evidence; do not weaken quality gates.
loop.plateau: If coverage stalls, investigate the measured residual rather than rerunning identical checks.
loop.deadline: Report achieved coverage and unresolved mass honestly; elapsed time does not authorize weak links.

efficiency.delegation: short task context, assigned write zones, original evidence paths, compact JSON handoffs
efficiency.data_processing: columnar Arrow/Parquet and DuckDB; batch deterministic checks; do not reason over every row with an LLM
efficiency.durable_state: run receipts, append-only diary/results and artifact index
